dog.description_text:
Chicken Tortilla is a 5-year-old Pug weighing around 22 pounds, and she's a social butterfly who loves just about everyone she meets! People, kids, babies, and other dogs, Chicken is always ready to make new friends! She's also always down for a party and loved attending her first Halloween party, where she happily greeted all the trick-or-treaters. She's incredibly gentle and patient with children, walks beautifully on a loose leash, and is always up for a good snuggle.

Chicken Tortilla is also a BIG fan of having canine companionship! She absolutely adores her foster sister and loves being close to her, whether they're cuddling together or just hanging out. She's looking for a loving home where she can enjoy plenty of affection, companionship, and cozy cuddle sessions.

Registered adopters interested in Chicken Tortilla can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
